---
title: "External on Start + Void"
description: "Native External Worker, the cutover artifact, and the cutover and Vercel rollback packet."
updatedAt: "2026-11-09"
audience: developers
---

External (`apps/external`) runs on TanStack Start, Vite+ and Void behind
[`@tuturuuu/start-bridge`](/build/devops/start-bridge). The Next.js build
(`build`) and the Vercel project stay in place until the cutover has been
stable, so the canonical host keeps a one-step route back.

## Worker

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Worker | `tuturuuu-external` (`void.config.ts`) |
| Flags | `workers_dev` and `preview_urls` off, `TUTURUUU_NOINDEX=1` |
| Routes | none; the hostname is attached at cutover by the release operator |
| Canonical host | `external.tuturuuu.com`; any other host answers `404` |

The Worker answers with the bridge error response unless it runs in production
mode, has the `ASSETS` binding, and all four of `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`,
`NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY`, `SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY` and
`TUTURUUU_APP_COORDINATION_SECRET` are present (names only recorded here).
`/api/storage/*` is closed to anonymous ingress and answers `403`. Other `/api/*`
paths forward to `INTERNAL_WEB_API_ORIGIN` (default `https://tuturuuu.com`).

## Build and artifact

`external-cloudflare.yaml` builds the Worker, checks bridge routes and native
types, records the emitted configuration receipt, runs
`node --test cloudflare/anonymous.runtime.mjs` against the emitted Worker, and
uploads `external-cutover-<source SHA>` containing `external-worker.tgz`, the
receipt and `SOURCE_SHA` (7 days). It never deploys. Do not run
`build:cloudflare` on a shared development machine.

## Cutover packet

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Worker | `tuturuuu-external` |
| Route | `external.tuturuuu.com/*`, operator-attached |
| Static assets binding | `ASSETS` (`dist/client`, `run_worker_first`) |
| Build command | `bun run --cwd apps/external build:cloudflare` with `NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=https://external.tuturuuu.com`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_WEB_APP_URL=https://tuturuuu.com` |
| Secrets (names) | `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY`, `SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY`, `TUTURUUU_APP_COORDINATION_SECRET` |
| Prior Vercel deployment | record the immutable deployment ID and URL of the `external` Vercel project before the switch |
| Data | no database writes and no migrations |

### Switch

1. Record the source SHA, artifact name and Vercel deployment ID.
2. Extract `dist`, provision the four secrets on `tuturuuu-external`, deploy,
   and run the smoke below against the Worker's own address.
3. Attach `external.tuturuuu.com` (a proxied route in front of the still-valid
   Vercel origin where possible).

### Smoke

```bash
# Entry route is anonymous 200
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' https://external.tuturuuu.com/
# Build identity matches the accepted SHA
curl -s https://external.tuturuuu.com/api/build-info
# Closed storage ingress
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' https://external.tuturuuu.com/api/storage/probe
# Foreign host is refused
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' -H 'Host: unknown.invalid' https://external.tuturuuu.com/
```

Expected: `200`, the accepted commit, `403`, `404`. The app has no login page of its
own; sign-in belongs to the central app.

### Rollback

- **Triggers:** 5xx above 1% for 5 minutes, any cross-host response, or an
  anonymous storage request that is not refused.
- **Action:** remove the Worker route (or repoint the mapping) so the host
  resolves to the recorded Vercel deployment. Never rebuild on the rollback path.
- **Data:** a route rollback changes no stored project data.
- **Stability:** keep the Vercel project and domain for 14 consecutive stable
  days before decommissioning, which is a separate approval.
